title: Make step ordering hooks more robust for optim
body:
Fixes #119300 

1. Adds ordering logic so that pre is before step and post is after. Tests this for both global and local step hooks
2. Leaves test_step_all_hooks untouched, as that exemplifies the ordering between global vs local hooks.
